title: Should Your Business Use Spotify Ads?

facts.fact: The page states that Spotify ad targeting can be based on age, gender, location, interests, and music tastes.
facts.quote: You can target ads based on age, gender, location, interests, and even music tastes.

facts.fact: The page states that Spotify video ads only show when the app is in use.
facts.quote: unless you opt for video, which only shows when the app is in use.

facts.fact: The page states that users can skip Spotify audio ads after a few seconds.
facts.quote: the ability for users to skip audio ads after a few seconds.

facts.fact: The page lists Spotify ad formats as audio clips between songs, video ads during browsing, and branded playlists.
facts.quote: Choose from audio clips that fit between songs, eye-catching video ads during browsing, or even branded playlists.

facts.fact: The page describes Sponsored Sessions as letting listeners get ad-free music for a bit thanks to the advertiser.
facts.quote: where listeners get ad-free music for a bit thanks to you

facts.fact: The page says Spotify offers various pricing levels but gives no specific prices or minimum budgets, noting only that comprehensive campaigns can be pricey, especially for smaller businesses.
facts.quote: While Spotify offers various pricing levels, launching a comprehensive ad campaign can be pricey, especially for smaller businesses.

facts.fact: The page describes Spotify as having millions of listeners tuning in daily, a vendor-agnostic description with no exact count.
facts.quote: Spotify has grown into a global audio streaming powerhouse with millions of listeners tuning in daily.
